concerns.location: plan.md:Full‑precision model: `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B` loaded via `transformers` in FP16.
concerns.text: The plan requires loading the 8‑billion‑parameter Llama‑3‑8B model in FP16 on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 vCPU, ≈7 GB RAM). This exceeds the available memory and compute capacity, making full‑precision gradient and curvature extraction infeasible within the 6‑hour budget. Consequently the hardware‑grounded dataset cannot be generated as described, violating the compute feasibility constraint.
